title: Claim Adjuster trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1754710 (0x001ac656), HLP file offset 443467 (0x0006c44b), topic 261 'Claim Adjuster'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Claim Adjuster; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 274, caption 'Claim Adjuster'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Claim Adjuster and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Claim Adjuster changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with Energy, Weapons and Propulsion tech 1 and Biotech tech 6 (documented-only).
Starts with a ship able to terraform other players' planets from orbit (documented-only).
Exclusive Retro Bomb, Orbital Adjuster and de-terraforming bombs (documented-only).
Terraforming is free and temporary; owned planets are terraformed each year to the current technology limit and revert on abandonment or capture (documented-only).

unresolved: The per-year terraforming application order and cap are unknown.
Temporary-state storage and reversion semantics are unknown.
Interaction with Total Terraforming is unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
